parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the resource properties. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

parameters.name: LogicalResourceId
parameters.description:
The name of resource property N that you want to query.

>  Maximum value of N: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The logical ID of the resource defined in the template.

parameters.name: ResourceAttributes
parameters.description:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

*   CREATE_COMPLETE
*   CREATE_FAILED
*   CREATE_IN_PROGRESS
*   UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS
*   UPDATE_FAILED
*   UPDATE_COMPLETE
*   DELETE_IN_PROGRESS
*   DELETE_FAILED
*   CHECK_IN_PROGRESS
*   CHECK_FAILED
*   CHECK_COMPLETE
*   IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS
*   IMPORT_FAILED
*   IMPORT_COMPLETE

parameters.name: ShowResourceAttributes
parameters.description: The name of resource property N that you want to query.

parameters.name: StackId
parameters.description: The ID of the region to which the stack belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros get-stack-resource --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --show-resource-attributes true --logical-resource-id WebServer --resource-attributes InstanceId --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros GetStackResource --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceAttributes.1 InstanceId --LogicalResourceId WebServer --ShowResourceAttributes true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
